title: Code and data for: Modelling temperature and velocity effects on migration energetics and spawning success of adult Chinook salmon in a regulated river
description: R scripts, input data, outputs and figures that reproduce the tables and figures of the article, an energy budget model of adult fall-run Chinook salmon migrating in the Sacramento River, California. See README.txt for how to run the scripts and a description of each data file.
